name: Nonton Tjapgomeh
source:
Batavia, January 1930.
On the night of the Lantern Festival, the city grows bright and restless.

Nonton Tjapgomeh is a short narrative game focusing on observation, quiet moments, and small choices during the Cap Go Meh night festival.

Inspiration (Historical & Literary References):
Nonton Tjapgomeh (1930) by Kwee Tek Hoay.
